# A table under a `for`, on every target.
#
# bubbletea keeps a bubbles model per copy of a widget a loop renders, and
# passImplicitState gives a table nobody binds a `selected` cell per copy. The
# copy accessor took the cell's value only for a widget whose value it syncs,
# which a table is not, while every call handed it the cell: `too many
# arguments in call to m.widget0Copy`. The call and the accessor now ask one
# question (copyTakesValue).

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component groups ui.node {
    var names = ["a", "b"]

    for var g = names {
        ui.text #title(value=g)
        ui.table(columns=["name"]) {
            ui.tableRow(cells=[g])
        }
    }
}

func testEachGroupHasItsTable(t test.Test, c groups) {
    t.assert(c.title[1] != null && c.title[1].value == "b")
}
